comment: Mirror these on the Constraints page in the FirstHelm dashboard. Constraints are typed templates with parameters — this sample shows the two that power the quickstart demo.

constraints.purpose: Actions pause mid-flight with NEEDS_APPROVAL until a human decides in Dashboard -> Approvals. Enable this to see human-in-the-loop in the demo.
Blocks any action once daily spend exceeds the limit. A costed action in the demo trips it when set low.
Actions outside the window are governed by the window policy — run the demo after hours to see it refuse.
